description: This file defines the 'ConditionalTernary' class in the Twig templating engine, representing a ternary conditional expression node in the Twig parser's abstract syntax tree. It includes methods for constructing, compiling, and managing operand escaping.

classes.name: ConditionalTernary
classes.description: Represents a ternary conditional expression within Twig's node system, allowing for conditional rendering logic in Twig templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ConditionalTernary node with test, true, and false expressions, and source code line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the ternary expression during Twig compilation.

methods.name: getOperandNamesToEscape
methods.description: Returns the list of operand names that should be escaped when rendering.
